# Assessment Overview

Supplementary architecture and application reference documents included with this assessment.

## Documents

- [architecture-diagram](./architecture-diagram.md) — Two-layer diagrams of the application architecture and component relationships.
- [dependency-map](./dependency-map.md) — Grouped external dependency inventory, compatibility risks, and test dependency status.
- [api-service-contracts](./api-service-contracts.md) — Application service catalog, page and upload contracts, communication patterns, and request sequence.
- [data-architecture](./data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, entity relationships, data ownership, and persistence behavior.
- [configuration-inventory](./configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, profiles, settings, secrets workflow, and runtime versions.
- [business-workflows](./business-workflows.md) — Catalog domain, browse/edit/upload workflows, and business rules.
